## Fall 1 – korrekt

```{sql}
#| setup: true
#| exercise: demo1
CREATE TABLE people (id INTEGER, name TEXT);
INSERT INTO people VALUES (1, 'Ada'), (2, 'Linus');
```

```{sql}
#| exercise: demo1
SELECT * FROM people;
```

```{sql}
#| check: true
#| exercise: demo1
SELECT COUNT(*) = 2 AS ok FROM people;
```
